acceptanceCriteria: A recorded run on at least one real Rails suite with passing receipts reports per-code counts, a hand-reviewed sample of INELIGIBLE verdicts (false-positive rate) and the abstention rate, in a build-log entry; any false positive becomes a BUG ticket.
body: Residual of V1-1866/V1-1867 (PR #1166, head 8a21fb19c, GH #1163/#1164). The new RB-* codes and inclusion-qualified verdicts were validated on fixtures only; no live Rails suite measurement of false-positive INELIGIBLE rate or abstention rate exists.
title: Qualify RB-* vacuous-expectation and inclusion rules against a real Rails suite (false-positive and abstention rates)
